Stale regional reads, repeated delivery and identifier allocation.

These **3 independent interview problems** are intended to train deep reasoning, not an oversized implementation.

1. [**Read Your Writes Across Two Regions**](../05-reliability-and-data/multi-region-consistency.qmd) — How can a user see their own update when the nearest replica is behind?

2. [**Reliable Notifications Without Double-Sending**](../05-reliability-and-data/notifications-at-least-once.qmd) — At-least-once brokers replay messages; external delivery itself may have unknown results.

3. [**URL Shortener: Unique IDs Under Concurrent Writers**](../05-reliability-and-data/url-shortener-ids.qmd) — What really makes generated links unique and stable through failover?

## The learning contract

For each problem identify the naive solution, exhibit a failure, derive the invariant, prove the correction, then reproduce a small part with the [NestJS lab](../lab/README.md). Production distribution requires extra atomicity, shared state or durable messaging where indicated.

$$
\text{Design}=\text{State}\ +\ \text{Transitions}\ +\ \text{Invariants}\ +\ \text{Failure model}.
$$

This is a **conceptual decomposition**, not a numeric equation.
